summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing Inducement Letters with holders of existing warrants for up to 584,492 shares, originally struck at $7.60–$27.60. Holders agreed to exercise for cash at a reduced $0.90 per share, generating gross proceeds of about $526,043 before fees. In consideration, the company will issue unregistered New Warrants for up to 1,168,984 shares (200% of exercised shares) at $0.90, exercisable only after Nasdaq stockholder approval. Closing expected on or about November 9, 2026. Net proceeds fund working capital; watch warrant overhang and stockholder vote timing.
